messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency SLO breach detected for inference-service us-east (slo: p99 < 750ms). Current p99=1620ms, p95=420ms. Query rate ~3.2k rps. Pager: https://pagerduty.fake/INC12345 :rotating_light:
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: INC12345 triggered -> urgent. Assigned to rotation: alex. Please acknowledge.
alex: Acked. I'm the oncall. Jumping in. Who's available for infra escalation if needed? @maria @sam
maria: I'm around, can take customer-impact and external comms. Sam can you check recent deploys and autoscaler health?
sam: Looking. I see a deploy to inference-runtime ~+11m ago, hash `c9f3a7b`. Sharing quick dashboard: https://grafana.fake/d/ABCD/latency?orgId=1 (live view). Logs show a spike of KV cache evictions starting at +7m before page.
devon: Observing high KV memory churn on sidecars in us-east-1a. Logs: ```2026-03-15T14:05:23Z sidecar: evict key=svc-prefix-3 size=2.1MiB cause=mem_pressure``` repeated ~8k/sec. Also seeing many 504s from backend workers.
api-team-bot (note): recent config change: sampler.batch_window_ms=12 -> 1 (applied in c9f3a7b) might increase small-batch churn.
alex: good catch. That config reduces batching delay — might increase sidecar pressure for many small requests. For mitigation: 1) revert sampler change OR 2) route critical traffic to fallback model variant with lower memory footprint. I'll try a quick rollback if deploy tool permits fast rollback.
alex: Initiating emergency rollback to previous release `b4d2e11` on inference-runtime for us-east. Command: ```./deploy rollback --service inference-runtime --region us-east --to b4d2e11 --now```
deploy-bot: rollout started: inference-runtime us-east -> rollback to b4d2e11 (initiated by alex). Tracking rollout id: r-98012.
sam: Checking autoscaler: sidecar autoscaler shows 95% CPU+mem in that AZ and hitting quota for adding pods; cluster autoscaler attempted to add but failed due to quota: `QuotaExceeded: Insufficient vCPU quota in us-east-1`. Opening cloud ticket with infra provider.
maria: Customers: a small % of requests showed timeouts (~0.6% errors) but some high-traffic accounts experienced degraded p99. I'm drafting a status note. Any ETA on rollback?
alex: Rollback started. Watching logs. Also going to toggle `continuous_batching=false` on routing layer as a short-term backstop. Command: ```curl -XPOST https://control-plane.internal/config -d '{"continuous_batching":false}'```
devon: After toggling continuous_batching off, sidecar eviction rate dropped by ~55% in the 45s window. p95 moved from 520ms -> 380ms so far. p99 still elevated ~1200ms.
sam: Cloud quota update: support acknowledged, escalated. Can't add nodes fast enough. Suggest we route lower-priority traffic to other region or spill to dedicated capacity pool.
alex: Spilling lower-priority traffic to dedicated pool now. Command: ```rbac route set-priority --service inference --region us-east --priority low --target dedicated-pool-2```
pagerduty-bot: INC12345 acknowledged by alex at 14:12:03Z.
maria: Noted external impact: a handful of large customers saw queued requests and some 504s. No data exfil. Working on a brief customer note.
deploy-bot: rollback r-98012: 30% rolled back -> 60% -> 100%. Rollback complete at 14:16:58Z.
alex: Rollback completed. Observing metrics: p95=360ms, p99=610ms, error rate back to 0.12%. Still above SLO but trending down.
devon: Heap graphs show memory pressure easing. KV evictions per sec down to normal baseline. Prom labels: `region=us-east, podgroup=inference-runtime-v2`
sam: Dedicated pool routing seems to have taken ~20% of low-priority traffic, easing load on autoscaler. Quota ticket still open.
maria: Customer note draft: "We've been investigating elevated inference latencies in us-east. We've rolled back a recent change and routed excess traffic to dedicated capacity. Some customers experienced brief timeouts; we're monitoring now and will follow up." Want quick peer review.
alex: LGTM - send it. Also leaving a TODO: follow-up postmortem to root-cause the config change and test batching config under load.
maria: Sent status to affected customers at 14:25Z.
devon: Current metrics snapshot (14:27Z): p95=340ms p99=480ms rps=2.9k errors=0.05% KV-evict-rate=baseline.
alex: I'm going to close the PD incident after 30m stable. Will handoff to oncall followup. Anyone want to take postmortem? Sam can lead infra/quotas, Dev-oncall (devon) can own runtime/caching. Maria will do comms.
sam: I can drive quota follow-up + file cloud request to increase vCPU quota in us-east.
devon: I'll own runtime analysis and add unit tests for sampler/batching config.
maria: I'll schedule a quick post-incident sync for 16:00 and create an incident doc: https://wiki.fake/INC12345
alex: Closing the circle: we'll run a load test of the new sampler config in staging and add canary gating for sampler changes.
pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: INC12345 -> Resolved by alex at 14:42:03Z (ack/rollback/route).
incident-bot: Resolution summary: root cause candidate = aggressive sampler.batch_window_ms change in recent deploy causing increased small-batch traffic -> KV cache thrash -> autoscaler + quota starvation -> p99 SLO breach. Mitigations applied: rollback, disable continuous batching, spill low-priority traffic to dedicated pool. Next steps: increase cloud vCPU quota, gating for sampler config, postmortem.
maria: Thanks all. Great coordination. :teamwork:
alex: Good work. I'm marking this thread resolved and will link the postmortem once ready.
